name: Zydus Wellness Ltd
title: Zydus Wellness Ltd-$ - 531335 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 domestic growth only 1.7% with seasonal brands down 9.8% as delayed summer left the trade pipeline unbuilt; consolidated growth of 62.1% is acquisition-driven, and management gave no numeric guidance.

triggers.label: Seasonal brands -9.8% in Q4
triggers.quote: the seasonal brands declined by 9.8%, whereas the skin and hair care brands registered a growth of 39.7%

triggers.label: Trade pipeline build did not happen
triggers.quote: The typically wholesale and pipeline buildup happens. This time, it has not happened.
triggers.highlight: This time, it has not happened.

triggers.label: Net profit down 43.2% for FY26
triggers.quote: Net profit declined by 5.8% during the quarter and 43.2% for the year.

triggers.label: 17-18% EBITDA margin target held
triggers.quote: we hope to get to our 17-18. Now we have without Comfort Click. So those numbers stay

guidance.value: 17-18% in next couple of years (ex Comfort Click)
guidance.quote: we hope to get to our 17-18. Now we have without Comfort Click. So those numbers stay

guidance.value: EPS accretive in Q4, guidance maintained for next two years
guidance.quote: we have become EPS accretive last quarter, but for the next two years. We, as we said, we maintain our guidance.

guidance.value: consistent double-digit growth over three to four years
guidance.quote: over a three to four -year period should deliver a consistent double-digit growth

guidance.value: 25% in FY28 and FY27-28; FY27 mix of cash and deferred tax asset
guidance.quote: So FY 27- 28 will be in the 25% bracket. But 26-27, it will be kind of cash plus deferred tax asset used.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we are holding on to what we said earlier, and we are in line with our expectation or slightly exceeded
we hope to get to our 17-18.

red_flags.label: Seasonal inventory and pipeline miss
red_flags.quote: we have got a little impacted by higher inventory

red_flags.label: Net profit down 43.2% for FY26
red_flags.quote: Net profit declined by 5.8% during the quarter and 43.2% for the year.

evasions.topic: Breakout of RiteBite vs other food brand growth
evasions.quote: It will not be possible for us. We've already given a directional indication of what is the growth of RiteBite.
So I'll not comment on the forward, but we've seen a late summer.
Beyond that, further geographical will be hard for us.
